business_summary: Cathay General Bancorp operates as the holding company for Cathay Bank that offers various commercial banking products and services to individuals, professionals, and small to medium-sized businesses in the United States. It offers savings accounts, checking accounts, money market deposit accounts, certificates of deposit, individual retirement accounts, and public funds deposits, and acceptance of checking, savings, demand deposits, time deposits, real estate, and consumer loans. The company also provides loan products, such as commercial real estate loans, commercial loans, small business administration loans, residential mortgage loans, real estate construction loans, and home equity lines of credit, and installment loans to individuals for household and other consumer expenditures. In addition, it offers trade financing, letter of credit, wire transfer, foreign currency spot and forward contract, safe deposit, overdraft, cash checking, automatic teller machine, Internet banking, investment, and other customary bank services, as well as investment products and services, such as stocks, bonds, mutual funds, insurance, annuities, and advisory services. The company was formerly known as Cathay Bancorp, Inc. and changed its name to Cathay General Bancorp in November 2003. Cathay General Bancorp was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, California.
business_summary_ko: Cathay General Bancorp는 미국의 개인, 전문가 및 중소기업에 다양한 상업 은행 상품과 서비스를 제공하는 Cathay Bank의 지주 회사로 운영됩니다. 저축 계좌, 당좌 예금 계좌, 머니 마켓 예금 계좌, 예금 증서, 개인 퇴직 계좌 및 공적 자금 예금을 제공하고 당좌 예금, 저축, 요구불 예금, 정기 예금, 부동산 및 소비자 대출을 허용합니다. 또한 회사는 상업용 부동산 대출, 상업 대출, 중소기업 행정 대출, 주택 담보 대출, 부동산 건설 대출, 주택 담보 신용 한도 대출, 가계 및 기타 소비자 지출을 위한 개인 대상 할부 대출 등의 대출 상품을 제공합니다. 또한, 무역금융, 신용장, 전신환 송금, 외화현물선도계약, 안전예금, 당좌차월, 현금체크, 현금자동입출금기, 인터넷뱅킹, 투자 및 기타 은행업무를 비롯하여 주식, 채권, 뮤추얼펀드, 보험, 연금, 자문 등의 투자상품 및 서비스도 제공하고 있습니다. 회사는 이전에 kno였습니다.
